sources.title: 崔錫鼎《明谷集》卷十三《與李壽翁書》盈縮加分、日法除与百刻→九十六刻
sources.provider: Wikisource (public received text), bibliographic identity checked against 韓國文集叢刊DB/MKS
sources.quality_notes: Two distinct letters under repeated 與李壽翁書 header: one explains 盈縮加分 vs 盈縮積 and 日下分*加分/日法; another explains 異乘同除 with 53*96/100=50.88 and 25*96/100=24. MKS open bibliography identifies 1721 大邱監營 print, 34卷15冊, NLC 한46-가1170 facsimile basis and SNU 奎1077 for damaged OTHER juan (22-24), but does not expose or authenticate this v13 target leaf. Wikisource mirrors are one received witness, not multiple originals. Neither 100/96 temporal scale nor the general term 加分 resolves native G893 一秒八十六少 or six variant finals.
